difficulty_reason: The counted statement identifies the cohomology of the zeroth local cohomology functor along a specialization-stable subset with a filtered colimit of the cohomologies with support in closed subsets (author lemma at source lines 996-1004, label lemma-adjoint-ext). The proof (source lines 1006-1017) is a short but complete computation: it represents the object by a K-injective complex, applies the definition of the functor as a filtered colimit over closed subsets, and uses exactness of filtered colimits to commute the colimit with taking cohomology (proof lines 1013-1017). Every step is written out, and the counted proof contains no cross-reference and no citation. H2.
